info.name: Wondercraft Public Account Audio Generation API
Create any audio content with an AI-generated script

items.docs: Generates audio content from a natural-language prompt. Wondercraft writes the script and synthesizes the audio. Optionally accepts voice IDs and a background music spec. Returns a job_id to poll for status.

info.name: Create any audio content with a user-provided script

items.docs: Generates audio from a user-provided script of ordered segments, each pairing text with a Wondercraft voice ID. Optionally accepts a background music spec. Returns a job_id to poll for status.
